unit_title: ምዕራፍ ፪ — Meraf 2: Grand Master of ሐ and መ

success_screen.headline_en: Spectacular! You are the Grand Master of ሐ and መ!
success_screen.headline_am: ግሩም ድንቅ ነው! የሐ እና የመ የደረጃ ፫ ዋና ጠቢብ ሆኑ!

games.title: Grand Decoder: HISAB
games.instructions_en: Match the native English phonetic spelling 'HISAB' (Math) with the correct Amharic word.

games.title: Grand Finish: መጽሐፍ
games.instructions_en: Find the missing breathy letter 'ሐ' to complete the Amharic word for 'Book': መጽ[ ? ]ፍ.
games.tips_en: The full word is መጽሐፍ (pronounced Met-shaf).

games.title: Master Sequence Check
games.instructions_en: Look at the pattern: 2nd form ➔ 4th form ➔ [ ? ] (6th form). What goes in the blank?

games.title: Grand Builder: ማር
games.instructions_en: Assemble the letters correctly to spell the Amharic word for Honey (Mar)!
games.tips_en: Tip: Select 4th form 'ማ', followed by 6th form 'ር'!

games.title: Grand Decoder: METSHAF
games.instructions_en: Match the phonetic spelling 'METSHAF' (Book) with the correct Amharic word counterpart.

games.title: Grand Audio Blend: ሕ
games.instructions_en: Listen closely to the light, breathy native 6th form 'H' sound of the ሐ family. Which symbol matches this silent form?
games.target_phonetic_description: The breathy 6th form native consonant sound: 'H'

games.title: Grand Builder: ሐኪም
games.instructions_en: Form the full Amharic word for Doctor (Hakim)!
games.tips_en: Tip: Select 'ሐ' (1st form), then 'ኪ' (3rd form), and end with 'ም' (6th form)!

games.title: Grand Decoder: HAKIM
games.instructions_en: Match the native English phonetic spelling 'HAKIM' (Doctor) with the correct Amharic word.
